essence: Mantra recitation is to be performed silently and kept secret.
Toḍalā protects the ears and Tripurā protects the speech of the practitioner.
Tripurā protects the sides and Kāmeśvarī protects the anus.
Mahāmāyā protects the feet and Kuleśvarī protects all limbs.
The goddess Mātaṅgī, situated at the brahmarandhra, should always protect.
